cases.sentence: Слово Господа, которое было к Софонии, сыну Кушия, сына Гедалии, сына Амарии, сына Езекии, во время правления ___ Иосии , сына Амона.
cases.explain: «иудейского царя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Yahweh’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

cases.explain: «торгового района» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

cases.explain: «великий день» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
